title: Dispatch interpretation through visitors
description: You can follow class-based dispatch from a tree node to its evaluation method.

steps.description: The node classes hold expression data. visit constructs visit_ClassName and invokes that method, falling back to an error for unsupported nodes.
Interpreter starts with an empty environment. Its binary visitor obtains child values and calls the selected arithmetic lambda.
Variable reads use the environment. Let saves and restores that dictionary on its normal return path, while IfExpr selects a branch to visit.

steps.question: Which visitor method receives the root of the supplied ast?
steps.answer: The root is Let, so dispatch selects visit_Let.

steps.description: The root binds x to 3 for its arithmetic body. The displayed interpreter result is 7.
